## Problem and result

Describe the concrete trigger, previous behavior and resulting behavior.

## Scope

List meaningful changes and any source/configuration/rules/index implications.

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results. Explain checks not run. Include sanitized UI evidence when relevant.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused and contain no credentials, private exports or personal data copied into examples.
- [ ] Input validation, ownership and current authorization boundaries are preserved where applicable.
- [ ] Data changes have source evidence and preserve missing-value/metric semantics where applicable.
- [ ] Appropriate unit/build/emulator/browser checks passed, or limitations are explained above.
- [ ] Documentation and relative links reflect the resulting behavior.
- [ ] Deployment, rules/index ordering, rollback and remaining risks are described where applicable.

## Maintainer decisions

Identify unresolved questions or required authorized operational work. Do not imply that live deployment or data mutation has already occurred unless verified.
